issues.description: Field mismatch for Animal.name: The exercise UML and task text declare the Animal.name attribute as type String (problem_statement.md line 27 shows "- name: String" and task text at line 85 asks for a getter and setter for the name). In the reference solution the backing field is declared as a StringBuilder: "private StringBuilder name;" (solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java line 4). This divergence between the specified attribute type (String) and the solution's declared field type (StringBuilder) is inconsistent with the UML and may confuse students about the expected attribute type and intended implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the reference solution with the UML/specification by changing the Animal.name field to a String: declare "private String name;". Update the constructor to assign the String directly (this.name = name;), have getName() return the String field, and setName(String newName) assign to the String field. This preserves the intended API and removes the mismatch with the problem statement.
